pages.title: FCC Monitor
pages.text: The $(item)FCC Monitor$() program is spectrum monitoring: who is on a frequency, and whether they are allowed to be. It needs a $(l:radiocraft:direction_finding/direction_finder)direction finder$(/l) touching the computer or on its data wire, and tunes it for you.$(br2)$(thing)F3$() types a frequency in MHz, the arrows step a channel, PgUp and PgDn ten channels, $(thing)F8$() clears the log.

pages.title: The verdict
pages.text: On the left, what the finder hears, its signal and its license status:$(li)$(thing)LICENSED$() and the holder, on a $(l:radiocraft:radios/commercial_licenses)licensed$(/l) frequency.$(li)$(thing)UNLICENSED$(), flashing with a beep, when someone transmits on a commercial frequency no license grants.$(li)AMATEUR BAND, CB, MARINE / WEATHER, or OUT OF BAND.$(br2)On the right, every signal heard while the program is open: how long ago, MHz, who and bearing.

pages.title: Finding them
pages.text: The bearing shows once the finder's modules lock on, with how sure it is. One bearing gives a line; take more from other places and the $(l:radiocraft:computer/direction_finding)Direction Finding$(/l) program finds where they cross. Fire alarm boxes and SCADA units show up here too: their bursts are on the air like any transmitter.$(br2)With licensing OFF on the server it says NOT CHECKED.
The $(item)FCC Monitor Floppy Disk$() has no recipe yet: it is in the creative menu.
